descriptions.w3d_d25g_ambient_sounds_start_800517a4: Starts the four ambient loops: when the audio loader exists, stamps the current time, gives each slot a random due time up to 870 ticks away and a clear wait, picks a random name that differs from the previous pick, loads it into the slot, sends it its position and calls its setup slot with (1, 0.0f); finally stores the level. Without a loader it calls the base start.
